title: Blacker-than-black holes above the insulator ring

tellings.quote: at all. They almost look like a bottomless pits in there. But I know they're solid.

plain: Bob Lazar says that in 1988 and 1989, at a secret site in Nevada he calls S-4, he saw holes above an insulator ring on a piece of equipment, holes so black they "almost look like a bottomless pits," though he knew they were solid. Lazar tells Michels this as something he saw with his own eyes, and he mentions a man named Barry as he tells it. If true, he was handling a material unlike anything ordinary.
